Implements the canonical normalization type-op path, so it is directly in the chain that decides whether the associated-type projection normalizes during function-body checking versus later at the call site.

Handles normalization of associated-type projections specifically, which is the core mechanism in the reproducer where `<&'a &'b () as Trait>::Type` can normalize to `()` in one param-env but not another.

Owns inferred outlives predicate computation and query wiring, so it is an upstream source of the implied bounds later consumed by borrowck and may be where projection-derived bounds are admitted too broadly.

Top-level type-check orchestration determines the param-env and the body-checking context that free-region relation construction relies on, so it is a plausible integration point for the regression.
